outcome: Maternal near miss (Class I, II, III)
cohort: The study included 7592 patients admitted and treated, accounting for 5713 deliveries, at a tertiary care centre.
finding: Of 280 cases of maternal morbidity and mortality, 95.35% were referred and 84.63% were unbooked, with cases classified as Class I (5%), Class II (51.4%), and Class III (46.4%) near-miss events.
